gambits.name: Advance
gambits.desc: Pieces, pawns and pawnlings in that lane push; +30% move speed for 20 s.

gambits.name: Hold the File
gambits.desc: Pieces in that lane defend; +44% armor and resist for 20 s.

gambits.name: Regroup
gambits.desc: Every living piece gathers at the point for 15 s.

gambits.name: Pawn Storm
gambits.desc: That lane's pawns and pawnlings deal +150% damage and move 75% faster for 15 s.

gambits.name: Check
gambits.desc: Marks an enemy piece: it takes 60% more damage for 8 s, visible to all.

gambits.name: Castle
gambits.desc: King and Rook swap places instantly.

gambits.name: Queen's Gambit
gambits.desc: Queen deals +120% damage for 12 s, then -20% for 6 s.

gambits.name: Siege
gambits.desc: Rook and its lane focus a Bastion or Throne; +90% structure damage for 10 s.

gambits.name: Sanctuary
gambits.desc: A zone that heals allies 10% max health per second for 6 s.

gambits.name: Fork
gambits.desc: Knight leaps to an enemy piece within reach and stuns it for 2.5 s.

gambits.name: Pawn Sacrifice
gambits.desc: Destroys one of your elite pawns in that lane. The nearest enemy Bastion there takes one hit of two and a half times that pawn's health, ignoring the structure damage cap.

gambits.name: Exchange
gambits.desc: One of your pieces gives up 25% of its current health; your whole team deals +44% damage for 10 s.

gambits.name: Poisoned Pawn
gambits.desc: Marks your front elite pawn in that lane for 20 s. Whoever kills it is slowed 40% for 6 s and their team loses 25 Tempo.

gambits.name: Barricade
gambits.desc: Seals the nearest gate path or lane crossing for 20 s. Nothing walks through it; units go around or wait.

gambits.name: Open File
gambits.desc: Your pieces, pawns and pawnlings in that lane move 38% faster for 15 s.

gambits.name: Outpost
gambits.desc: Plants a banner for 25 s. Your units near it get +60 armor and +60 resist.

gambits.name: Zugzwang
gambits.desc: The enemy discards its dearest card in hand (14 Tempo or more). That slot refills after 15 s instead of 6.

gambits.name: Time Trouble
gambits.desc: The enemy loses 30 Tempo now and earns Tempo 30% slower for 20 s.

gambits.name: Opening Book
gambits.desc: Your other cards are redealt from your Opening's two schools (from any school with the Italian Game).

gambits.name: Increment
gambits.desc: For 30 s, every card you play gives back 5 Tempo (a card never costs you less than 3).

gambits.name: Breakthrough
gambits.desc: Your next pawnling wave in that lane comes with 6 extra melee pawnlings.

gambits.name: Pin
gambits.desc: An enemy piece cannot move for 4 s, and the enemy piece nearest behind it is slowed 40% for 3 s. A pinned piece can still attack and cast.

gambits.name: Desperado
gambits.desc: One of your pieces under 40% health deals 120% more damage for 6 s; if it falls in that time, your team gets 10 Tempo back.

gambits.name: Fortify
gambits.desc: Your front Bastion in that lane (the Throne if none stand) gets a shield of 40% of its max health for 20 s.
